risks.risk: Console may not be included/working (photo shows box and controllers, not a powered-on console).
risks.proof: A short video of the actual PS4 Pro powering on to the home screen, plus a close-up of the console ports while cables are connected.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified/possibly not working until powered-on proof.

risks.risk: Ports may be faulty (HDMI/USB/Ethernet/charging) even if the console exists.
risks.proof: Photo or video showing HDMI connected to a TV with display, and at least 2 USB devices/controllers recognized.
risks.if_unproven: Price as ports not guaranteed; treat as worst-case for resale.

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues (common with older units) not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Video clip showing gameplay for 15–20 minutes with no shutdowns, plus a temperature/thermal check app screenshot if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential overheating risk (worst-case: may require servicing).

risks.risk: Controllers/accessories may be non-original, incomplete, or have drift/charging issues.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of controller model labels + a video showing analog sticks responding and charging working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers not guaranteed original and not guaranteed fully functional.

risks.risk: “Never opened or repaired” may be false; internal repairs can affect reliability.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the console serial label and any warranty/inspection stickers (if present) and a photo of the underside/serial plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as previously opened/unknown service history.

risks.risk: Receipt authenticity/ownership not verifiable remotely; could be missing or unrelated.
risks.proof: Photo of the UK receipt with sensitive details blurred, matching the console serial/model.

proof_requests: Video of the actual PS4 Pro powering on and reaching the home screen (not just the box).
Close-up photos of the console front/back ports and the serial/model label (serial should match any receipt).
Video showing HDMI output working on a TV and at least two USB ports working (controller + another USB device).
Video/gameplay clip for 15–20 minutes to demonstrate no overheating/shutdowns.
Photos of the controllers’ labels and a quick test showing analog movement and charging.
Photo of the UK receipt (with personal details blurred) and confirmation it matches the console serial.
response.reason: The item identity (PS4 Pro) is only supported by the box text, while key value drivers—console power-on status, port functionality, overheating behavior, and receipt/accessory authenticity—are not provable from the single photo. Request proof before pricing.
